$comment: Diner keys added before the screens that render them. check-used-keys.mjs accepts these while nothing references them; once a screen uses a key it prints a note, and the entry should be deleted. An entry is a full key or a prefix ending in .* — the value says who renders it.

keys.place.reviews.seeAll: D1 — 'See all N reviews' on the place screen
keys.place.menu.*: D1 — the place screen's menu empty and error states
keys.place.review.hidden: D1 — ReviewComposer when the diner's own review is hidden
keys.place.review.report.*: D1 — the report sheet on each review
keys.place.bookingsOff.*: D1 — replaces Book when acceptsAppBookings is false
keys.booking.note.*: D1 — the booking note field, success screen and booking detail
keys.tab.name.*: D2 — the optional name prompt on pending and tab screens
